test_title: PYST 75: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

Jerry driving / home late / when the incident / took place.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the auxiliary verb "**was**" before the term "**driving**."
 
• In the past continuous tense, which is used to describe an action that was happening at a specific time in the past, the verb "was" is required as an auxiliary for the subject "Jerry."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**Jerry was driving**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Jerry was driving home late when the incident took place."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "took place." **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "when the incident **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "home late"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
